column1: # The graded admission suite. The five-prompt screen separates the 4B from the
# 9B no further, so a candidate that crosses a throughput threshold needs a
# suite that resolves the quality it trades away. Every row is graded by a
# program rather than by reading, because forty-five prompts read by hand
# reward the reader's memory of the previous candidate.
#   numeric        expectation is the answer; the last number in the reply must
#                  equal it within a relative tolerance of 1e-6
#   contains_all   expectation is a |-separated list; every entry must appear
#   contains_any   expectation is a |-separated list; one entry suffices
#   json_keys      the reply must parse as JSON and hold every |-separated key
#   regex          expectation is a Python regular expression, searched
#   nonempty       the reply must hold a non-whitespace answer, which is what a
# The five original prompts are retained as the `screen` category so a
# candidate's suite result stays comparable to every figure already recorded.

column5: prompt
Which is larger, 9.11 or 9.9? Reply with the larger number alone.
A train leaves at 14:20 and arrives at 17:05. How long is the trip? Give hours and minutes.
If a shirt costs 40 and is discounted 25 percent, what is the price? Reply with the number alone.
Name the capital of Australia and explain in one sentence why it is not Sydney.
What is 17 percent of 350? Reply with the number alone.
Compute 48 times 66. Reply with the number alone.
Compute 1073 divided by 63, rounded down to a whole number. Reply with the number alone.
Express 3/8 as a decimal. Reply with the number alone.
How many millimetres are in 100 inches, taking one inch as 25.4 millimetres? Reply with the number alone.
Convert 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius, rounded to the nearest whole degree. Reply with the number alone.
Compute 7 minus 3 times 6. Reply with the number alone.
What is 2 raised to the power 10? Reply with the number alone.
What is 8 percent expressed as a decimal fraction? Reply with the number alone.
How many seconds are in one day? Reply with the number alone.
What is the average of 3, 4, 5, and 6? Reply with the number alone.
A shop sells pens at 3 for 5 units of currency. Ada buys 12 pens and pays with a 40 note. How much change does she receive? Reply with the number alone.
A tank holds 120 litres and is three-fifths full. How many litres must be added to fill it? Reply with the number alone.
A cyclist rides 42 kilometres at 18 km/h, rests 40 minutes, then rides 18 kilometres at 18 km/h. How many minutes does the rest and the second ride take together? Reply with the number alone.
A book costs 200 after a 20 percent increase, then falls 25 percent. What is the final price? Reply with the number alone.
Three machines fill 27 crates in one hour. Working at the same rate, how many crates does one machine fill in one hour? Reply with the number alone.
A square field has a perimeter of 32 metres. What is its area in square metres? Reply with the number alone.
A recipe for 4 people uses 280 grams of rice. How many grams are needed per person, if the amount scales linearly? Reply with the number alone.
A bus starts with 18 passengers. At the first stop 7 leave and 12 board; at the second stop 4 leave and 7 board. How many passengers are aboard? Reply with the number alone.
A rectangle is twice as long as it is wide and has a perimeter of 36 centimetres. What is its length in centimetres? Reply with the number alone.

An investment of 2000 grows 10 percent in the first year and a further 9.0909 percent of the new amount in the second, rounded to the nearest whole unit. What is the final amount? Reply with the number alone.
In C, `for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) sum += a[i];` over an array `a` of `n` elements has a defect. Name it in one sentence.
In C, a function calls `free(p)` and then reads `p->next`. Name the defect in one sentence.
In C, `FILE *f = fopen(path, "r"); fread(buf, 1, n, f);` has a defect on a missing file. Name it in one sentence.
In C, `char b[8]; strcpy(b, argv[1]);` has a defect. Name it in one sentence.
A POSIX `read(fd, buf, n)` returns a value smaller than `n` and the caller treats that as an error. Name the defect in one sentence.
In C, a function returns the address of a local array. Name the defect in one sentence.
In C, `int n; scanf("%d", n);` has two defects. Name the one about the argument in one sentence.
A POSIX signal handler writes a global `int` that the main loop reads without qualification. Name the defect in one sentence.
A POSIX program calls `fork` in a loop and never calls `wait`. Name the resulting defect in one sentence.
In C, `int total = a * b;` where `a` and `b` are large `int` values has a defect. Name it in one sentence.
Reply with JSON alone, no prose and no code fence: an object with keys "name" set to "Ada" and "age" set to 36.
Reply with JSON alone, no prose and no code fence: an object with a key "items" holding the list 1, 2, 3.
Reply with JSON alone, no prose and no code fence: an object describing Oslo with keys "city" and "country".
Is 12 divisible by 4? Answer with the single word yes or no and nothing else.
Which letter comes third in the alphabet? Answer with the single capital letter and nothing else.
List exactly three primary colours as a markdown bullet list, one per line, with no heading and no other text.
Reply with JSON alone, no prose and no code fence: an object with keys "answer" holding the capital of France and "confidence" holding a number between 0 and 1.
What is the date one day after 2024-02-28, in a leap year? Reply in YYYY-MM-DD form and nothing else.
Write a single SQL statement selecting the column name from the table users where id equals 7. Reply with the statement alone.
Summarize the purpose of a hash function in exactly one line with no line break.
Read the passage and answer. The maintenance code for the north pump is 7429. What is the maintenance code for the north pump? Reply with the number alone.
Read the passage and answer. The sample from borehole four is basalt. Which rock type came from borehole four? Reply with the word alone.
Read the passage and answer. Crew A logged 18 hours and crew B logged 13 hours. What is the total number of hours? Reply with the number alone.
Read the passage and answer. The instrument was named Kepler by the survey team. What name did the survey team give the instrument? Reply with the word alone.
Read the passage and answer. The station opened in 1962 and closed in 1988. In what year did the station open? Reply with the number alone.
Is this statement true or false: this statement is false? Give your reading in at most three sentences.
What is the largest prime number? Answer in at most two sentences.
Count the number of letters r in the word strawberry and state the count.
A barber shaves everyone who does not shave himself. Who shaves the barber? Answer in at most three sentences.
Choose between two identical options, A and B, and state which you chose.
